qualification_boundaries: Both complete src trees captured from current local bytes, plus actual fast_io/bizwen/boost_unordered headers and test/debugger sources. Each src has 118 changed and 10 new files relative to R57. Later peer edits are excluded.

Ordinary VM uses its separately pinned LLVM23 provider; ROS is freshly compiled with genuine canonical bundled 23.1.1-uwvm-ros.12 X86 archives and generated repair capability header. The version check was never relaxed or spoofed.

The local LLVM manifest differed from seven concurrent MIPS/LoongArch files. Only private pinned source bytes matching all 12874 canonical manifest entries were recovered from SHA-matching preserved sources; local peer files remain untouched. Other ISA provider parity is not qualified.

The language CLI source fingerprint intentionally excludes Finder metadata; the derived before/after fingerprints independently match all semantic src bytes in the original complete successful build pins. Original manifest/build receipts are retained.

Direct scalar constant CLI and DAP cases use compiler-original C/C++ Wasm32 DWARF4/5 O1. Direct DW_AT_const_value origin is verified against the actual DIE, concrete parent/type, thread/stop and actual Code offset. It is separate from copied locals or location-expression constants.

Genuine Source variables, Watch, Hover and variables evaluate contexts agree on negative/signed, unsigned and bool constants; variables are readOnly and expose no memoryReference. Queued old frame/scope/evaluate references fail after one real Wasm instruction and fresh frames reacquire provenance.
Current scalar, caller, composite, false bool, float, primitive, C/Rust/TinyGo/Zig controls are finite real broker/DAP coverage; all original guest OS waits, broker waits and DAP EOFs are checked.

Sixteen architectures execute only the portable copied-value/type DATA component. Actual ELF machine/width/endian, inputs, dependency hashes and stdout parity are checked, not full target VM/JIT/DAP/native IDE behavior.

No full native debugger parity, every language ABI, standard Go/AssemblyScript completeness, all optimized locations, float/block/aggregate DW_AT_const_value, guest calls, assignments or watchpoints is claimed.
